materials_exhausted.note: Fresh worker-6 re-review reopened the handoff packet, XML/PDF-derived text, OA archive listing, supplementary landing-page captures, locator index, and linked database rows. No additional locally recoverable blocker was found.

adjudication_summary: Source re-review repaired the Table 2 activity matrix, reconciled linked database rows against Table 1/2/3, preserved one database value conflict plus database-only CAMP annotations, and limits mechanism claims to phenotypic evidence. The paper is publication-grade only as accepted_with_cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and literature rows were source-reviewed against Table 1/2/3 and article metadata. Matching rows are source_verified; the Citropin MBEC value mismatch remains source_conflict; CAMP rows without paper-specific assay values remain database_only_no_primary_source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 and Table 3 are now represented as concrete endpoint rows with raw values, units, targets, assay context, and XML locators; database-only rows are not used as primary assay evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The source supports antibacterial, antibiofilm, and cytotoxicity/selectivity phenotypes, but not direct molecular mechanism categories; background mechanism references are not promoted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: One linked database MBEC row does not match the primary Table 2 value and remains source_conflict rather than being normalized away.
Eight CAMP overlap rows are generic/database-only annotations and are retained as non-primary provenance.
Some IC50 values are table-reported with a prior-study footnote; they are retained with that limitation.
Local supplementary captures are HTML landing pages, not additional data tables; XML/PDF/OA package carried the evidence needed for the repaired layers.
No paper-local direct molecular mechanism assay was found; mechanism ontology is limited to phenotypic activity context.
